capabilities: Schedule unscheduled tasks into free gaps in a week view as accept-or-drag proposals
Read durations and dates from plain task lines or the Obsidian Tasks syntax
Write Day Planner-format time ranges back into notes without reformatting them
Draw a read-only ICS calendar feed on the grid and treat its events as busy
Review planned versus kept work and roll unfinished tasks into the next week
extras: Desktop only (manifest claims no mobile support); early 0.2.0 release that the author suggests trying first in a scratch vault; requires Obsidian 1.7.2+; no account, server, or telemetry; weekly review output is readable by Obsidian Bases tables.
intentEvidence: Fit this week | Schedules unscheduled work into your free slots. Nothing else in the directory does this
problem: Obsidian task lists say what to do but not when, and comparable planners require annotating every task with durations or dates before they can schedule anything.

relations.evidence: Weekfit writes Day Planner format — the same HH:MM - HH:MM lines the Day Planner plugin already renders
If you use Tasks, keep using it — Weekfit reads its syntax rather than replacing it
Weekfit defers to the Periodic Notes plugin when you have it installed

summary: Task scheduler that fits unscheduled tasks into free slots in a week view and writes the plan back as plain-text time lines.
